[EN] Strange Flask
[ES] Frasco extraño
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please bring me what is inside the {@creature:46#7002#jermol extractor}.
[ES] Por favor, tráeme lo que está dentro del {@creature:46#7002#jermol extractor}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] What you brought me will be helpful for my research.
[ES] Lo que trajiste me será de utilidad para mi investigación.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Dead Animals in the Extractor
[ES] Animales muertos en el extractor
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Pass through the {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crusher} guarding the rooms in {@Rgn:46003$$Raga Shadi} of {@Rgn:46001#the Three Towers} and break the {@creature:46#7002#jermol extractor}. Then collect the dead animals inside the extractor.
[ES] Atraviesa al {@creature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crusher} que custodia las habitaciones en {@Rgn:46003$$Raga Shadi} de {@Rgn:46001#the Three Towers} y rompe el {@creature:46#7002#jermol extractor}. Luego recae los animales muertos dentro del extractor.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the {@Rgn:46019$$Beastroar Chamber} and deliver the dead animals to {@linkcreature:246#1025$$Alecian}
[ES] Ve a la {@Rgn:46019$$Beastroar Chamber} y entrégale los animales muertos a {@linkcreature:246#1025$$Alecian}
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll help."
[ES] "Te ayudaré".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@linkcreature:246#1024$$Platanok} in the {@Rgn:46020$$Shineroot Chamber}.
[ES] Ve con {@linkcreature:246#1024$$Platanok} en la {@Rgn:46020$$Shineroot Chamber}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
